name: [Farewell] Digimon Aurity [Farewell]
desc:
Digimon Aurity is shutting down, it will be replaced by a new game called "Virtumon Aurity". I'm phasing out the VIP Servers so don't be alarmed by the sudden price spike, it's just to prevent people from buying any more. The conversion will likely take more than a month, so enjoy Aurity in its current state while you can.  Your purchases and stats will transfer.

Thank you for everything you have all done for us.
